title: Preallocate ANALYZE schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when ANALYZE builds schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added analyze_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced load_analyze_schema() schema lookup key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: ANALYZE schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving statistics collection, EXPLAIN statistics consumption, and DDL behavior.
